correctness.rationale: Independent verification confirms the universal parity disproof. Lemma 1 (div=2 on F2) follows directly from BM08 Def 3.1 combined with F_n data dl={0^a}, dr={n^a} (checked in ar5iv 0812.3354 Sec 2-3 and Sec 6.3 polygon (0,0),(na+b,0),(0,a),(b,a)): theta(v)=0 forces div(v)=2 for every floor at any (a,b), genus 0. Lemma 2 (o_r=0) follows because o_r counts odd-divergence vertices in m(Im), of which there are none, so (-1)^{o_r}=+1 identically. Proposition mu^R_r in {0} U Z_{>0} is then immediate from Def 3.8: either the even-edge/r-real condition forces 0 or the value is +prod_{e in A} w(e) >=1. The finite script is corroboration only; re-ran output/artifacts/verify.py to VERIFY_OK with zero negatives over 9 diagrams and archived ledgers including vacuous-zero (weight-2 elevator) and positive (r-sums 6,6,4,2) witnesses. ADMISSION_DEFECT: topic.audit_preflight cheap_falsification outcome and target_integrity nonvacuity premise that sample F2 markings include opposite-sign cancelling pairs is false under the same Def 3.8; the proof shows no such pair exists at any degree. This strengthens rather than weakens the disproof, whose universal quantifier rests on analytic lemmas, not the window.
